faqs.a: Vellops builds AI chatbots for local business websites. Your chatbot is trained on your services, prices, FAQs and hours, and lives on your own website: it answers visitor questions instantly day and night, handles customer service and sales conversations, captures leads (name, email, what they need), and books appointments into your calendar. Every new lead and conversation summary is emailed to you, and your Monday report shows chats handled, leads captured, and booked. This chat is the product itself — you're using it right now.

Plans run $397/month for Starter, $497/month for Standard — that's the one we recommend — and $597/month for Premium. There's no setup fee at all. No contract — cancel by reply. Live in about 7 days. You can also start with a free 14-day live trial: we install the chatbot on your website free, no card, and you only pay if you decide to keep it.

Two guarantees, both in our written terms. First: if the first 30 days book nothing, we refund them — proactively, before you ask. Second: before you pay, you get a written summary stating the number of customer conversations we promise to deliver in your first 60 days; if we don't deliver them, we work free until we do, and month 2 is refunded. We never guarantee closed jobs or revenue — no honest service can.

Yes. If we quoted you specific pricing in writing — for example, a founding-customer rate — we honour that quote exactly as written, even though it's no longer our public offer. Tell me what you were quoted and we'll set it up on those terms.

faqs.a: Different job entirely. Vellops works on your website, where your visitors are: it answers their questions in the chat, handles service and sales, captures the lead, and books the appointment — then emails you the lead and the conversation summary. Nothing about your phone setup changes.

faqs.a: No contract. Cancel by reply — just reply to any email from us. It's month-to-month from day one — there's no term to choose and no setup fee.

You do — your calendar, your conversation records, and your lead lists are yours, exportable any day. We never sell conversation records or lists. Chat logs are stored so we can run the service, show you every conversation, and send your Monday report; the details are in our privacy policy.
Vellops is run by MS ECOM LLC, based in Troy, Michigan. We're a small team focused entirely on AI chatbots for local business websites.

We build your chatbot and install it on your website, live, free for 14 days — no card required.
